C. Enum Values

allocation_type

Value Meaning
fixed Employees earn a set amount of balance each allocation period.

expiration_type

Value Meaning
no_expiration Balance never expires.
in_months Balance expires after a fixed number of months. Requires expire_in_months.
on_selected_date Balance expires on a specific day/month each year. Requires expire_custom_day, expire_custom_month, and minimum_expiry_months.

balance_details.allocation_frequency

Value Meaning
annually Once per year. Requires renewal_day and renewal_month.
monthly Once per month. Requires monthly_renewal_type.
anniversary On the employee's work anniversary each year. renewal_day / renewal_month not required.

balance_details.initial_balance_allocation

Value Meaning
on_renewal_date First allocation on the next balance renewal date.

balance_details.monthly_renewal_type

Value Meaning
selected_day Allocate on a fixed day each month. renewal_day must also be set.

balance_details.limit_type

Value Meaning
limited Policy sets a maximum; amount defined by allocation_base_details tiers.
unlimited No cap on balance allocation.

balance_details.balance_reference_date_type / allocation_criteria[].balance_reference_date_type

Value Meaning
0 Join date.
1 Contract sign date.
2 Custom date field (requires custom_reference_id).

balance_details.balance_ranges[].rounding_method

Value Meaning
round_up Round fractional balance up within this range.

request.description:
Fetch detail of employee's shift request.

A. Resource Identifier

This endpoint uses company_id and user_id as resources identifier. The company_id will be passed by the hmac signature to limit the user access.
The user_id as path variable is used to limit attendance request for specific employee.

B. Request Parameter

Parameter Type Required (Y/N) Description
requestId Integer Y Id of shift request

C. Response Body

Field Name Type Description
detail_shift_request Object of Detail Shift Request result Employee's detail shift request list for requested parameter

C.1 Shift Request Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Id of the attendance request
company_id Integer CompanyId of requester
user_id Integer UserId of requester
effective_date String Requested date for effective date
current_shift Integer Id of current shift
changed_shift Integer Id of changed shift
pattern_id Integer id of pattern
reason String Request shift reason
schedule_id Integer id of schedule
approved_status Integer Integer of request status: 1 = Pending, 2 = Approved, 3 = Rejected, or 4 =Canceled
approved_by String Approver name
created_date String Request's creation timestamp
app_date
updated_date String Request's last update timestamp
old_shift_name String Requested name for old shift
old_schedule_in String Requested date for old schedule in
old_schedule_out String Requested date for old schedule out
new_shift_name String Requested name for new shift
new_schedule_in String Requested date for new schedule in
new_schedule_out String Requested date for new schedule out
status Integer Shift request status:
1 = Pending, 2 = Approved, 3 = Rejected, or 4 =Canceled
approval_date String Request's date for approval
approval_list Object of Request Approval List Approval list of this request

C.2 Request Approval List

Field Name Type Description
pic String Approval line's name
status String Approval status
approved_by String Approver's name
approval_date String Approval datetime
approval_level Integer Approval level
reason String Approval reason
updated_date String Approval last update timestamp

request.description:
Allowed the client application to fetch a list of change shift request used for approval for a certain company. The company identifier will be passed through the HMAC authentication. This endpoint supports pagination to limit the data.

A. Request Parameters

Query Parameters Type Required Definition
status Integer N Filter status approval_flag to fetch the change shift request data
query String N Filter sender name to fetch the change shift request data
page Integer N Page to fetch the change shift request data

B. Response Body

Field Name Type Description
message String Response message description (reason of successful and error)
data Object Result object
data.change_shift_request Change shift request object Result of change shift request object
errors Array of String List of error reasons (if any)

B.1 Change Shift Request Object

Field Name Type Description
inbox Array of Inbox Request Object Response list of inbox request data
pagination Object Pagination Result object

B.2 Inbox Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Inbox request identifier
sender_id Integer Request sender identifier
receiver_id Integer Request receiver identifier
subject String Inbox request subject request
message String Inbox request message
inbox_type Integer inbox type attendance request
fk_ref Integer Foreign Key refer to change shift request identifier
read_flag Integer Inbox request read status
created_date String Inbox request created timestamp
updated_date String Inbox request updated timestamp
delete_flag Integer Inbox request deleted status
approval_flag Integer Inbox request approval status
avatar String Sender avatar file that will expired in 30 minutes after the request
sender Sender Object Sender data

B.3 Sender Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Request sender identifier
first_name String Request sender first name
last_name String Request sender last name
avatar String Sender avatar filepath that will expired in 30 minutes after the request

request.description:
POST /v2/talenta/v2/shift/change-request

This endpoint is used to submit a change request for a shift.

Request Body

  • reason (string, required): The reason for the shift change request.

  • user_id (number, required): The ID of the user for whom the shift change is requested.

  • current_shift (number, required): The ID of the current shift.

  • changed_shift (number, required): The ID of the shift to which the user wants to change.

  • effective_date (string, required): The effective date for the shift change.

Response

The response will be a JSON object with the following schema:

{
  "message": "string",
  "data": {
    "shift": {
      "user_id": 0,
      "current_shift": 0,
      "changed_shift": 0,
      "reason": "string",
      "effective_date": "string"
    }
  }
}

  • message (string): A message indicating the result of the shift change request.

  • data (object): The data object containing the details of the shift change request.

    • shift (object): The shift object with the following properties:

      • user_id (number): The ID of the user for whom the shift change is requested.

      • current_shift (number): The ID of the current shift.

      • changed_shift (number): The ID of the shift to which the user wants to change.

      • reason (string): The reason for the shift change request.

      • effective_date (string): The effective date for the shift change.

request.description:
POST /v3/shift — Create Shift V3

Create a shift for the caller's company via the PLUE shift service.

Traced from internal/plue/shift/handler.go (PostShiftV3). The code is the source of truth.

Auth

Wrapped in DoSSOIntegration. Send SSO headers:

Header Required Meaning
X-SSO-User-ID yes* SSO user id
X-MAG-Client-ID yes* Mekari Gateway client id
X-Forwarded-For yes Client IP

*Either X-SSO-User-ID + X-MAG-Client-ID, or X-SSO-Company-ID.

Request body (shift.PostShiftV3Request)

Required: name, schedule_in, schedule_out (times in HH:MM).

Conditional-required:

  • clock_in_attendance_validation, clock_out_attendance_validation when enable_attendance_validation = true

  • auto_overtime_before, auto_overtime_after (HH:MM) when enable_auto_overtime = true

  • eligibility_criteria when eligible_to_all_employees = false

Example request

{
  "name": "Morning Shift",
  "code": "MS-01",
  "schedule_in": "08:00",
  "schedule_out": "17:00",
  "break_start": "12:00",
  "break_end": "13:00",
  "shift_color": "#4CAF50",
  "description": "Standard morning shift",
  "shift_label": "Morning",
  "enable_attendance_validation": true,
  "clock_in_attendance_validation": 30,
  "clock_out_attendance_validation": 30,
  "enable_clock_in_grace_period": 15,
  "enable_clock_out_grace_period": 15,
  "multiple_break_schedule_id": null,
  "enable_auto_overtime": false,
  "location_setting_id": null,
  "show_in_request": true,
  "eligible_to_all_employees": true
}

Response

Envelope: { "message": string, "data": object, "errors": []string } (fields omitted when empty).

⚠️ Double-enveloped: data contains a second wrapper — data.shift, data.status, data.errors.

200 OK

{
  "message": "success",
  "data": {
    "shift": {
      "id": "550",
      "type": "shift",
      "attributes": {
        "id": 550, "name": "Morning Shift", "code": "MS-01", "recess": true,

        "job_level_id": [], "job_position_id": [], "branch_id": [], "organization_id": [], "employee_status": [], "sbu": [],
        "work_start": "08:00", "work_end": "17:00", "recess_start": "12:00", "recess_end": "13:00",
        "overtime_in": "", "overtime_out": ""
      }
    },
    "status": 200,
    "errors": []
  }
}

Errors

400 validation · 401 unauthorized · 500 service error

request.description:
Fetch list of employee overtime history shift.

A. Resource Identifier

This endpoint uses company_id and user_id as resources identifier. The company_id will be passed by the hmac signature to limit the user access.
The user_id as path variable is used to limit shift attendance for specific employee.

B. Request Parameter

Parameter Type Required (Y/N) Description
year Integer Y Year in yyyy format
month Integer Y Month in m format
status Integer N Filter response by attendance request status: pending, approved, rejected, or canceled
page Integer N Pagination
limit Integer N Limit record perpage, between 1 - 100

C. Response Body

Field Name Type Description
overtime_request Array of Overtime Request object result Employee overtime request list for for requested parameter
pagination Pagination object result Response's data pagination

C.1 Overtime Request Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Id of the attendance request
description String Requested description
status_approval Integer Overtime request status: 0 = Pending,
1 = Rejected,
2 = Approved,
3 = Canceled
request_date String Requested date for overtime request
created_date String Request's timestamp
approved_by String Approver name
approved_date String Approved date

C.2 Pagination Object

Field Name Type Description
current_page String Current page number
first_page_url String First page URL
from String Starting offset being shown
last_page String Last page number
last_page_url String Last page URL
next_page_url String Next page URL
path String Request path URL
per_page String Records per page
prev_page_url String Request's timestamp
to String Ending offset being shown
total String Total records

request.description:
Allowed the client application to fetch a list of overtime request used for approval for a certain company. The company identifier will be passed through the HMAC authentication. This endpoint supports pagination to limit the data.

A. Request Parameters

Query Parameters Type Required Definition
status Integer N Filter status approval_flag to fetch the overtime request data
query String N Filter sender name to fetch the overtime request data
page Integer N Page to fetch the overtime request data

B. Response Body

Field Name Type Description
message String Response message description (reason of successful and error)
data Object Result object
data.overtime_request Overtime request object Result of overtime request object
errors Array of String List of error reasons (if any)

B.1 Change Shift Request Object

Field Name Type Description
inbox Array of Inbox Request Object Response list of inbox request data
pagination Object Pagination Result object

B.2 Inbox Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Inbox request identifier
sender_id Integer Request sender identifier
receiver_id Integer Request receiver identifier
subject String Inbox request subject request
message String Inbox request message
inbox_type Integer inbox type overtime request
fk_ref Integer Foreign Key refer to overtime request identifier
read_flag Integer Inbox request read status
created_date String Inbox request created timestamp
updated_date String Inbox request updated timestamp
delete_flag Integer Inbox request deleted status
approval_flag Integer Inbox request approval status
avatar String Sender avatar file that will expired in 30 minutes after the request
sender Sender Object Sender data
overtime Overtime Object Overtime data

B.3 Sender Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Request sender identifier
first_name String Request sender first name
last_name String Request sender last name
avatar String Sender avatar filepath that will expired in 30 minutes after the request

B.3 Overtime Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Overtime object identifier
compensation_type Integer
request_date String Overtime request date
hour Integer Hour of overtime request
minutes Integer Minute of overtime request
hour_before Integer Hour before of overtime request
minutes_before Integer Minutes before of overtime request
total_hour Integer Total hour of overtime request
total_minute Integer Total minute of overtime request

request.description:
Allowed the client application to fetch detail of overtime request used for approval by inbox identifier in a certain company .This endpoint uses user_id as resources identifier.

A. Request Parameters

Query Parameters Type Required Definition
inboxId Integer Y inbox identifier used
status String N should be pending, approve, rejected
query String N refers to requester

B. Response Body

Field Name Type Description
message String Response message description (reason of successful and error)
data Object Result object
data.detail_overtime_request Overtime request object Result of overtime request object
errors Array of String List of error reasons (if any)

B.1 Change Shift Request Object

Field Name Type Description
inbox Array of Inbox Request Object Response list of inbox request data

B.2 Inbox Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Inbox request identifier
sender_id Integer Request sender identifier
receiver_id Integer Request receiver identifier
subject String Inbox request subject request
message String Inbox request message
inbox_type Integer inbox type overtime request
fk_ref Integer Foreign Key refer to overtime request identifier
read_flag Integer Inbox request read status
created_date String Inbox request created timestamp
updated_date String Inbox request updated timestamp
delete_flag Integer Inbox request deleted status
approval_flag Integer Inbox request approval status
sender Sender/ Receiver Object Sender data
receiver Sender/ Receiver Object Receiver data
reason_approved String Approval reason
overtime_request Overtime Request Object Overtime Request data
shift Shift Object Shift data
check_in String check in timestamp
checkout String check out timestamp

B.3 Sender/ Receiver Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Request sender identifier
first_name String Request sender first name
last_name String Request sender last name
avatar String Sender avatar filepath that will expired in 30 minutes after the request

B.4 Overtime Request Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Overtime request identifier
company_id Integer Company identifier
user_id Integer User identifier
description String Description of overtime request
reason String Reason of overtime request
hour Integer Hour of overtime request
minutes Integer Minutes of overtime request
status_approval Integer Approval status for overtime request
request_date String Request date for overtime request
schedule_in String Overtime schedule clock in time
schedule_out String Overtime schedule clock out time
hour_before Integer Hour before of overtime request
minutes_before Integer Minutes before of overtime request
beforetime_break String Before time break timestamp of overtime request
aftertime_break String After time break timestamp of overtime request
before_approved String Before Approve
after_approve String After Approved of overtime request
compensation_type Integer Compensation type of overtime
create_date String Created date of overtime request
approval_list Approval List Object List of approval
overtime_rounding Overtime Rounding Object Overtime rounding for overtime request
approved_by Integer Approved by object for overtime request
approval_by Integer Approval by for overtime request
approved_date String Approved date for overtime request

B.5 Approval List Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer approval list identifier
pic String PIC name
approved_by String approver name
approver_user_id Int approver user identifier
reason String Approval reason
updated_date String Approval update date
status String Approval status

B.6 Overtime Rounding Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Overtime rounding identifier
company_id Integer Company identifier for overtime rounding
from Integer Overtime rounding from
to Integer Overtime rounding to
round Integer Overtime rounding round

B.7 Shift Object

Field Name Type Description
category_id Integer Category shift identifier
get_company_shift Company Shift Object Company Shift data

B.8 Company Shift Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Company shift identifier
schedule_in String Company schedule in timestamp
schedule_out String Company schedule out timestamp
name String Company name

request.description:
Bulk Add Jobs

Creates many jobs in one request. The request is synchronous. The response has the result for each job.

Method: POST
Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/jobs/bulk-add
Content-Type: application/json

Purpose

Use this endpoint to:

  • Create from 1 to 1000 jobs in one request.

  • Get a result for each job. A response with status 200 can include jobs that failed.

The authenticated user is the creator of all jobs in the request. This user must exist in Recruitment and must have the permission to create job listings.

A large request can reach the gateway timeout. Send smaller requests when the timeout is a risk.

Request body

Field Name Type Required Description
jobs array of object Yes Job objects. 1 to 1000 items. Refer to Job Object (request)

Request rules:

  • The body must be valid JSON and 5 MB or less.

  • A request that has no job, or more than 1000 jobs, is rejected.

  • Each status must be valid (see Job Object). An error here rejects the whole request.

  • Fields that are not in the table below are ignored.

1. Job Object (request)

Field Name Type Required Description
job_listing_title string No Job title (the job alias). Maximum 255 characters
recruiter array of integer No User IDs of the recruiters. Get the IDs from /reference/users
hiring_manager array of integer No User IDs of the hiring managers
interviewer array of integer No User IDs of the interviewers
job_position_id integer No Job position ID
branch_id integer No Branch ID
organization_id integer No Organization ID
employment_type_id integer No Employment type ID
working_type_id integer No Working type ID. See Reference values
province_id integer Yes* Province ID. Get the IDs from /reference/provinces
city_id integer Yes* City ID. Get the IDs from /reference/provinces/:id/cities
headcount integer No Number of positions to fill
is_headcount_public boolean No Show the headcount on the career page
min_salary integer No Minimum salary
max_salary integer No Maximum salary
is_salary_public boolean No Show the salary on the career page
salary_currency string No Currency code. Default IDR. Get the codes from /reference/currencies
salary_description string No Salary description
description string No Job description. HTML is allowed. Maximum 2500 characters of text
requirements string No Job requirements. HTML is allowed. Maximum 2500 characters of text
benefits string No Job benefits. HTML is allowed. Maximum 2500 characters of text
job_summary string No Job summary
last_education_id integer No Minimum education level. Get the IDs from /reference/educations
experience_level_id integer No Experience level. Get the IDs from /reference/experience-levels
min_experience integer No Minimum experience
gender_id integer No Gender requirement
min_age integer No Minimum age
max_age integer No Maximum age
status string Yes draft, published, unpublished, or closed
publish_date string Yes, if status is published RFC 3339 date and time (example: 2026-07-01T00:00:00+07:00). Only the date is kept
closing_date string No RFC 3339 date and time. Only the date is kept
sbus array of object No SBU pairs. Refer to SBU Pair (request)

* province_id and city_id are required, unless the company setting "province and city optional" is on.

2. SBU Pair (request)

Field Name Type Description
sbu_group_id integer SBU group ID. Must be a positive ID of an active group in the company
sbu_id integer SBU ID. Must be a positive ID of an active SBU in the group

If the company has a Modular package, the service accepts sbus but ignores it.

Defaults

The service adds these values when you do not send them:

  • Hiring stages: the default hiring stages of the company.

  • Job platforms: Career Page is published. LinkedIn and JobStreet are not published.

  • Application form of the job: only job_id, hiring_stage_id, first_name, last_name, and email are mandatory for a candidate.

  • salary_currency: IDR.

Row errors

A job that fails is in data.failed with a reason. If a job has more than one error, the reasons are joined with ; . Reasons include:

Reason Cause
province_id is required, city_id is required The field is missing
job_alias must be less than or equal to 255 characters job_listing_title is too long
job_position_id is invalid, branch_id is invalid, organization_id is invalid, employment_type_id is invalid The ID is not found for the company
user_id is invalid A user ID in recruiter, hiring_manager, or interviewer is not a user of the company
benefits must be less than 2500 character (also description, requirements) The text is too long
closing_date must be a valid RFC3339 datetime, publish_date must be a valid RFC3339 datetime The date format is not valid
sbus[_].sbu_group_id is required and must be a positive id_ (also sbu_id) The SBU pair is not valid
published job quota exceeded The company has no published-job quota for the job

Response Body

Field Name Type Description
status string success
message string success
data object Response data
data.total_submitted integer Number of jobs in the request
data.total_success integer Number of jobs created
data.total_failed integer Number of jobs that failed
data.succeeded array of object Refer to Succeeded Job
data.failed array of object Refer to Failed Job
request_id string Unique request identifier

1. Succeeded Job

Field Name Type Description
index integer Position of the job in the request (starts at 0)
job_id integer ID of the new job
job_listing_title string/null The title that you sent. null if you did not send it
sbu_groups array of object SBU groups of the job: id (integer), name (string). Empty array if none
sbus array of object SBUs of the job: id (integer), name (string), sbu_group_id (integer). Empty array if none

2. Failed Job

Field Name Type Description
index integer Position of the job in the request (starts at 0)
reason string Reason that the job failed

Request errors (whole request)

HTTP status errors
400 invalid request body:
400 jobs must not be empty
400 jobs must not exceed 1000 records
400 jobs[_].status '' is not valid; allowed: draft, published, unpublished, closed_
400 jobs[_].publish_date is required when status is published_
403 The user is not found in the company, or has no permission to create job listings

Example Request

curl -X POST 'https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/jobs/bulk-add' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "jobs": [
      {
        "job_listing_title": "Senior Backend Engineer",
        "recruiter": [1001],
        "job_position_id": 2001,
        "branch_id": 1,
        "organization_id": 3001,
        "employment_type_id": 1,
        "province_id": 1,
        "city_id": 1,
        "headcount": 2,
        "description": "<p class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml'>Job description.</p>",
        "requirements": "<p class='preserveHtml' class='preserveHtml'>Job requirements.</p>",
        "benefits": "Health insurance",
        "status": "published",
        "publish_date": "2026-07-01T00:00:00+07:00",
        "sbus": [{ "sbu_group_id": 7, "sbu_id": 21 }]
      }
    ]
  }'

Example Response

  "status": "success",
  "message": "success",
  "data": {
    "total_submitted": 2,
    "total_success": 1,
    "total_failed": 1,
    "succeeded": [
      {

      }
    ],
    "failed": [
      { "index": 1, "reason": "branch_id is invalid" }
    ]
  },
  "request_id": "<request-id>"
}

request.description:
Bulk Add Candidates

Creates many candidate applications in one request. The request is synchronous. The response has the result for each candidate.

Method: POST
Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/candidates/bulk-add
Content-Type: application/json

Purpose

Use this endpoint to:

  • Add from 1 to 1000 candidate applications in one request.

  • Get a result for each candidate. A response with status 200 can include candidates that failed.

Upload the files first with /candidates/upload. Use the returned file_url in resume_url, profile_picture_url, and portfolio.

Request body

Field Name Type Required Description
candidates array of object Yes Candidate objects. 1 to 1000 items. Refer to Candidate Object (request)

Request rules:

  • The body must be valid JSON and 5 MB or less.

  • A request that has no candidate, or more than 1000 candidates, is rejected.

  • Two candidates in the same request must not have the same job_id and email. If they do, the whole request is rejected.

  • Fields that are not in the tables below are ignored.

1. Candidate Object (request)

Field Name Type Required Description
job_id integer Yes Job ID. The job must belong to the company. Get it from /jobs
created_by string Yes Email of an active Recruitment user of the company. This user is the creator of the application
hiring_stage_id integer Yes ID of a hiring stage of this job. Use job_hiring_stages[].id from /jobs/:job_id
first_name string Yes First name
last_name string Yes Last name
email string Yes Candidate email
phone_number string No Candidate phone number
last_job_position string No Last job position
last_company string No Last company
last_education integer No Education level, from 0 to 7. See Education Level
applicant_source string No Free-text source of the application (example: linkedin). The entry channel is always "Open API"
application_date string No Not used. The application date is the date that the application is created
resume_url string No file_url from /candidates/upload with type=resume
profile_picture_url string No file_url from /candidates/upload with type=profile_picture
is_portfolio_online boolean No true if portfolio is an online link
portfolio string No An online link, or file_url from /candidates/upload with type=portfolio
gender_id integer No See Reference values
marital_status_id integer No See Reference values
blood_type_id integer No See Reference values
religion_id integer No See Reference values
place_of_birth string No Place of birth
date_of_birth string No YYYY-MM-DD
nik string No NIK
passport_number string No Passport number
passport_expiration_date string No YYYY-MM-DD
postal_code string No Postal code
citizen_id_address string No Address on the identity card
residential_address string No Current address
current_salary integer No Current salary
current_salary_currency string No Currency code of current_salary. If you do not send it, no currency is stored
expected_salary integer No Expected salary
expected_salary_currency string No Currency code of expected_salary. If you do not send it, no currency is stored
nationality_id integer No Nationality ID
total_years_of_experience integer No Whole number, 0 or more
question array of object No Answers to the custom questions of the job. Refer to Answer Object (request)
formal_education array of object No Refer to Formal Education Object (request)
informal_education array of object No Refer to Informal Education Object (request)
work_experience array of object No Refer to Work Experience Object (request)

A date that cannot be read (wrong format) in date_of_birth, passport_expiration_date, or in the education and work experience objects is ignored. No error is returned.

2. Answer Object (request)

Field Name Type Description
id integer custom_question[].id of the job
answer string The answer

3. Formal Education Object (request)

Field Name Type Description
degree_id integer Education level. See Education Level
institution_name string Institution name
major string Field of study
gpa number Grade. Stored with 2 decimal places
start_year integer Start year (example: 2013)
end_year integer End year

4. Informal Education Object (request)

Field Name Type Description
name string Course or certificate name
issuing_organization string Issuing organization
issue_date string YYYY-MM-DD
expiration_date string YYYY-MM-DD
duration integer Duration value
unit integer 0 Days, 1 Hours
degree string Degree
grade string Grade

5. Work Experience Object (request)

Field Name Type Description
company_name string Company name
job_title string Job position
start_date string YYYY-MM-DD
end_date string YYYY-MM-DD
is_current boolean true if the candidate works here now
description string Description of the work
work_description string Description of the work. Required when the job asks for it and the company setting for company location is on
company_location string Company location. Same rule as work_description
reason_for_leaving string Reason for leaving
monthly_salary integer Monthly salary
monthly_salary_currency string Currency code of monthly_salary
supervisor_name string Supervisor name
supervisor_email string Supervisor email

The application form of the job decides which of the work experience fields above the job accepts. A value for a field that the job turns off is rejected.

Row errors

A candidate that fails is in data.failed with a reason. If a candidate has more than one error, the reasons are joined with ; . Reasons include:

Reason Cause
created_by '' not found in company No active Recruitment user has this email
applied_position is invalid job_id is not a job of the company
initial_stage is invalid hiring_stage_id is not a hiring stage of the job
phone_number is invalid The phone number format is not valid
last_education is invalid last_education is not from 0 to 7
gender_id is out of range (also marital_status_id, blood_type_id, religion_id, last_education, formal_education[_].degree_id_) The value is not in the list of Reference values
is required The application form of the job makes the field mandatory (for example phone_number is required, resume is required)
nik must be numeric, nik must be 16 digit, is already exist The identity fields do not follow the rules of the job form
total_years_of_experience must be a non-negative whole number The value is below 0
: (example: work_experience[1].monthly_salary_currency: ...) A work experience, nationality, or currency rule failed

For a job that was created with Bulk Add Jobs, only job_id, hiring_stage_id, first_name, last_name, and email are mandatory.

Response Body

Field Name Type Description
status string success
message string success
data object Response data
data.total_submitted integer Number of candidates in the request
data.total_success integer Number of candidates created
data.total_failed integer Number of candidates that failed
data.succeeded array of object Refer to Succeeded Candidate
data.failed array of object Refer to Failed Candidate
request_id string Unique request identifier

1. Succeeded Candidate

Field Name Type Description
index integer Position of the candidate in the request (starts at 0)
job_application_id integer ID of the new application. Use it in /candidates/:job_application_id
candidate_email string Candidate email

2. Failed Candidate

Field Name Type Description
index integer Position of the candidate in the request (starts at 0)
candidate_email string Candidate email
reason string Reason that the candidate failed

Request errors (whole request)

HTTP status errors
400 invalid request body:
400 candidates array cannot be empty.
400 candidates array exceeds maximum of 1000 records.
400 duplicate (job_id, email) at index _: job_id= email=._

Example Request

All values are examples.

curl -X POST 'https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/candidates/bulk-add' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "candidates": [
      {
        "job_id": 1001,
        "created_by": "<recruiter-email>",
        "hiring_stage_id": 5001,
        "first_name": "Jane",
        "last_name": "Doe",
        "email": "<candidate-email>",
        "phone_number": "<candidate-phone>",
        "last_education": 5,
        "applicant_source": "linkedin",
        "resume_url": "<file_url from upload>",
        "question": [{ "id": 11, "answer": "Yes" }],
        "formal_education": [
          { "degree_id": 5, "institution_name": "Example University", "major": "Computer Science", "gpa": 3.8, "start_year": 2013, "end_year": 2017 }
        ],
        "work_experience": [
          { "company_name": "Example Company", "job_title": "Backend Developer", "start_date": "2018-01-01", "end_date": "2022-12-31", "is_current": false }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }'

Example Response

{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "success",
  "data": {
    "total_submitted": 2,
    "total_success": 1,
    "total_failed": 1,
    "succeeded": [
      { "index": 0, "job_application_id": 91400, "candidate_email": "<candidate-email-1>" }
    ],
    "failed": [
      { "index": 1, "candidate_email": "<candidate-email-2>", "reason": "phone_number is invalid" }
    ]
  },
  "request_id": "<request-id>"
}

request.description:
Upload Candidate File

Uploads one file. Use the returned file_url in Bulk Add Candidates.

Method: POST Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/candidates/upload Content-Type: multipart/form-data

Purpose

Use this endpoint to upload a resume, a portfolio, or a profile picture before you call Bulk Add Candidates. Send one file for each request.

Form fields

Field Name Type Required Description
type string Yes resume, portfolio, or profile_picture
file file Yes The file to upload. Maximum request size is 10 MB

Allowed files

type Allowed extensions Allowed content types
resume .pdf, .doc, .docx, .txt, .rtf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg application/pdf, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, text/plain, text/rtf, application/rtf, image/png, image/jpeg
portfolio .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .pdf image/png, image/jpeg, application/pdf
profile_picture .png, .jpg, .jpeg image/png, image/jpeg

The extension check is not case-sensitive. The service finds the content type from the file extension.

Response Body

Get Job List (v3)

Returns a paginated list of jobs for a company.

Method: GET
Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/jobs

Purpose

Use this endpoint to:

  • Get the jobs of a company, newest first.

  • Find a job_id for /jobs/:job_id and for Bulk Add Candidates.

  • Filter jobs by keyword, branch, job position, and publish state.

Query parameters

Param Type Default Description
page integer 1 Page number. A value that is not an integer, or is below 0, gives the default
per_page integer 10 Items per page. A value that is not an integer, or is below 0, gives the default. There is no maximum
keyword string None Search keyword (example: Engineer). Matches, in part and without case, the job alias or the job ID. Also matches the jobs of job positions and branches that the Talenta search finds for the keyword (the first 100 of each)
branch_id string None Filter by branch ID. For more than one ID, use a comma-separated list (example: 1,2)
job_position_id string None Filter by job position ID. For more than one ID, use a comma-separated list
is_publish string None Send 1 to return only jobs that are live on the career page: status published, publish_date today or earlier, and published on the Career Page platform. Any other value gives no filter

Pagination

Use page and per_page to paginate. The response has data.pagination.

Response Body

message string success
data object Response data
data.jobs array of object Refer to Job Object

request_id string Unique request identifier

job_id integer Job ID

working_type_id integer Always 0 in this list. Use /jobs/:job_id
working_type_name string Always empty in this list. Use /jobs/:job_id
province_id integer/null Always null in this list. Use /jobs/:job_id
province_name string/null Always null in this list
city_id integer/null Always null in this list. Use /jobs/:job_id
city_name string/null Always null in this list
headcount integer Number of positions to fill
headcount_filled integer Number of positions filled
status string draft, published, unpublished, or closed
status_label string Draft, Published, Unpublished, or Closed
publish_date string/null Publish date. null if empty
closing_date string/null Closing date. null if empty
summary object Job summary
summary.all_candidates integer Number of candidates of the job

request.description:
Get Job Detail (v3)

Returns the full data of one job.

Method: GET Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/jobs/:job_id

Purpose

Use this endpoint to:

  • Get the full data of a job, including its hiring stages and custom questions.
  • Get the job_hiring_stages[].id for hiring_stage_id, and the custom_question[].id, for Bulk Add Candidates.

Path parameters

Param Type Required Description
job_id integer Yes Job ID. Get it from /jobs. A value that is not an integer returns 400 job_id should be integer. A value that is 0 or less, or more than 2147483647, returns 400 invalid job id.

A job that is not found in the company returns 403.

Response Body

Field Name Type Description
status string success
message string success
data object Refer to Job Detail Object
request_id string Unique request identifier

1. Job Detail Object

Field Name Type Description
job_id integer Job ID
company_id integer Company ID in Recruitment
company_name string Company name
job_listing_title string/null The job slug (not the title). Use job_alias for the title
job_position_id integer Job position ID
job_position_name string Job position name
job_alias string/null Job alias (the title that you send in Bulk Add Jobs)
job_level_id integer/null Job level ID. null if not set
job_level_name string/null Job level name
job_function string/null Job function
job_function_name string/null Job function name
branch_id integer Branch ID
branch_name string Branch name
organization_id integer Organization ID
organization_name string Organization name
employment_type_id integer Employment type ID
employment_type_name string Employment type name
working_type_id integer Working type ID. See Reference values
working_type_name string Working type name
province_id integer/null Province ID
province_name string/null Province name
city_id integer/null City ID
city_name string/null City name
headcount integer Number of positions to fill
headcount_filled integer Number of positions filled
is_headcount_public boolean The headcount is shown on the career page

is_benefit_public boolean The benefits are shown on the career page

salary_description string/null Salary description

requirements string Job requirements (HTML)
benefits string/null Job benefits
job_summary string/null Job summary
education_ids array of integer Required education level IDs
education_names array of string Required education level names
last_education_id integer/null Minimum education level ID. null if 0
experience_level_id integer/null Experience level ID. null if not set, or if 0 (Internship)

max_age integer/null Maximum age. null if 0

closing_date string/null Closing date
publish_duration integer/null Publish duration. null if 0

slug string/null Job slug

custom_question array of object Refer to Custom Question Object
job_hiring_stages array of object Refer to Job Hiring Stage Object
job_platform array of object Refer to Job Platform Object
summary object Job summary
summary.all_candidates integer Number of candidates of the job
sbu_groups array of object SBU groups: id (integer), name (string). Empty array if none
sbus array of object SBUs: id (integer), name (string), sbu_group_id (integer). Empty array if none

2. Creator Object

Field Name Type Description
id integer User ID
id_employee string Employee ID
first_name string First name
last_name string Last name

role_name string Role name

job_position string/null Job position

threshold number Score threshold

id integer Question ID. Use it as question[].id in Bulk Add Candidates

is_mandatory boolean The answer is required

request.description:
Get Candidate List (v3)

Returns a paginated list of candidate applications for a company.

Method: GET Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/candidates

Purpose

Use this endpoint to:

  • Get the candidate applications of a company, newest first.
  • Search candidates by name.
  • Filter applications by application date and by new joiner.

Query parameters

Param Type Default Description
page integer 1 Page number. Minimum 1
limit integer 10 Items per page. From 1 to 100
search string None Search keyword. Matches, in part and without case, the full name (first name and last name) of the candidate
sort_by string applied date Allowed values: candidate_id, job_application_id, job_position_id, job_id, job_position_name, branch_name, first_name, last_name, joining_date, candidate_name, hired_date. Only candidate_name sorts the list. For the other allowed values the list has no defined order. If you do not send sort_by, the list is sorted by application date
order string desc Sort direction: asc or desc
application_date_start string None Application date, YYYY-MM-DD. Used alone, it returns the applications of this exact date. Used with application_date_end, it starts the date range
application_date_end string None End of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. The range includes both dates. A value without application_date_start is ignored. If the end date is before the start date, the list is empty
new_joiner_ids string None Comma-separated list of integer new joiner IDs. Returns only the candidates with status Hired that have these new joiner IDs

Not valid values return 400 with one message for each parameter:

  • page param must be an integer and greater than 0
  • limit param must be an integer and between 1 to 100
  • new_joiner_ids param must be comma separated int
  • A message about the date format for application_date_start or application_date_end
  • order param can only :asc, desc
  • sort_by param can only :<allowed values>

Pagination

Use page and limit to paginate. The response has data.pagination. When data.candidates is empty, the URL fields of the pagination object are empty.

Response Body

Field Name Type Description
status string success
message string Successfully get candidate list
data object Response data
data.candidates array of object Refer to Candidate Object
data.pagination object Refer to Pagination Object
request_id string Unique request identifier

1. Candidate Object

Field Name Type Description
candidate_id integer Candidate ID
job_application_id integer Application ID
company_id integer Company ID in Recruitment
job_id integer Job ID
job_position_id integer Job position ID
job_position_name string Job position name
branch_id integer Branch ID

organization_id integer Organization ID
organization_name string Organization name
candidate_name string Full name
first_name string First name
last_name string Last name
email string Candidate email
phone_number string Candidate phone number
last_job_position string Last job position
last_company string Last company
last_education integer Education level ID. See Education Level
last_education_level string Education level name
avatar string Profile picture URL. The URL expires
applied_date string Application date and time (ISO 8601)
status integer Application status. See Reference values
source integer Entry channel. See Reference values
source_name string Entry channel name
applicant_source string Free-text source of the application. Empty if not given
last_stage_id integer Last stage ID
last_stage_name string Last stage name
hiring_stage_id integer Current hiring stage ID
hiring_stage_status integer Status of the current stage. See Reference values
hired_date string/null Hired date
joining_date string/null Joining date
new_joiner_status string New joiner form status
new_joiner_expired_date string/null Expiry date of the new joiner form

originalRequest.description:
# Recruitment Candidates

This endpoint retrieves a list of candidates for recruitment.

## Request

### Query Parameters

- `page` (integer) - The page number of the results.
    
- `limit` (integer) - The maximum number of candidates to be returned per page.
    

Example:

```
{{host_tda_v3}}/recruitment/candidates?page=1&limit=10

 ```

## Response

The response will be a JSON object with the following schema:

``` json
{
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "candidates": [
      {
        "candidate_id": 0,
        "job_application_id": 0,
        "company_id": 0,
        "job_id": 0,
        "job_position_id": 0,
        "job_position_name": "",
        "branch_id": 0,
        "branch_name": "",
        "organization_id": 0,
        "organization_name": "",
        "candidate_name": "",
        "first_name": "",
        "last_name": "",
        "email": "",
        "phone_number": "",
        "last_job_position": "",
        "last_company": "",
        "last_education": 0,
        "last_education_level": "",
        "avatar": "",
        "applied_date": "",
        "status": 0,
        "source": 0,
        "source_name": "",
        "last_stage_id": 0,
        "last_stage_name": "",
        "hiring_stage_id": 0,
        "hiring_stage_status": 0,
        "hired_date": null,
        "joining_date": null,
        "new_joiner_status": "",
        "new_joiner_expired_date": ""
      }
    ],
    "pagination": {
      "current_page": 0,
      "first_page_url": "",
      "from": 0,
      "last_page": 0,
      "last_page_url": "",
      "next_page_url": "",
      "path": "",
      "per_page": 0,
      "prev_page_url": "",
      "to": 0,
      "total": 0
    }
  }
}

 ```

The `candidates` array contains details of the candidates, and the `pagination` object provides information about the current page, total count, and navigation URLs.

request.description:
Get Candidate Application Detail (v3)

Returns one candidate application with the personal data, education, and work experience of the candidate.

Method: GET Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/candidates/:job_application_id

Purpose

Use this endpoint to get the full data of one application. The response contains personal data (for example NIK, passport number, address, and salary). Store and share it only as the data protection law (UU PDP 27/2022) and the company policy allow.

Path parameters

Param Type Required Description
job_application_id integer Yes Application ID. Get it from /candidates or from Bulk Add Candidates. A value that is not an integer returns 400 job_application_id should be integer. An application that is not found returns 400 job_application_id is invalid or not found

Response Body

Field Name Type Description
status string success
message string Successfully get candidate application
data object Refer to Candidate Application Object
request_id string Unique request identifier

1. Candidate Application Object

Field Name Type Description
job_application_id integer Application ID
job_id integer Job ID
first_name string First name
last_name string Last name
last_job_position string Last job position
last_company string Last company
email string Candidate email
phone_number string Candidate phone number
resume string Resume URL. The URL expires
profile_picture string Profile picture URL. The URL expires
last_education integer Education level ID. See Education Level
is_portfolio_online boolean true if portfolio is an online link
portfolio string Portfolio link or file URL
status integer Application status. See Reference values
hiring_stage_id integer Current hiring stage ID
application_date string Application date and time (RFC 3339)
tags array of string Tags of the application
question array of object Refer to Question Object. Can be null
gender_id integer Gender ID. 0 if not set
gender_name string Gender name. Empty if not set
marital_status_id integer Marital status ID
marital_status_name string Marital status name
blood_type_id integer Blood type ID
blood_type_name string Blood type name
religion_id integer Religion ID
religion_name string Religion name
postal_code string Postal code
sensitive_field_access boolean Always true in this API
place_of_birth string Place of birth
date_of_birth string Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss. Empty if not set
nik string NIK
passport_number string Passport number
passport_expiration_date string/null Passport expiration date, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
citizen_id_address string Address on the identity card
residential_address string Current address
current_salary integer Current salary
expected_salary integer Expected salary
formal_education array of object Refer to Formal Education Object. Can be null
informal_education array of object Refer to Informal Education Object. Can be null
work_experience array of object Refer to Work Experience Object. Can be null
nationality object/null Refer to Nationality Object. The key is always present
total_years_of_experience integer/null Total years of experience. The key is always present
comment array of object Refer to Comment Object. Newest first. Empty array if there is no comment

The values that you can send in Bulk Add Candidates for current_salary_currency, expected_salary_currency, monthly_salary, monthly_salary_currency, and supervisor_email are not in this response.

2. Question Object

Field Name Type Description
id integer Question ID
question string Question text
answer string Answer
custom_field_id integer Custom field ID

3. Formal Education Object

Field Name Type Description
institution_name string Institution name
degree integer/null Education level ID. See Education Level
field_of_study string Field of study
start_year string/null Start year
end_year string/null End year
grade string Grade

4. Informal Education Object

Field Name Type Description
name string Course or certificate name
issuing_organization string Issuing organization
issue_date string/null Issue date
expiration_date string/null Expiration date
duration integer Duration value
grade string Grade
unit integer/null 0 Days, 1 Hours
degree string Degree

5. Work Experience Object

Field Name Type Description
id integer Record ID
job_position string Job position
company_name string Company name
start_date string/null Start date
end_date string/null End date
is_current boolean true if the candidate works here now
company_location string/null Company location
work_description string/null Always null in this API
reason_for_leaving string/null Always null in this API
supervisor_name string/null Always null in this API

6. Nationality Object

Field Name Type Description
id integer Nationality ID
name string Nationality name

nationality is null if the candidate gave no value, or if the job does not ask for it.

7. Comment Object

Field Name Type Description
id integer Comment ID
content string Comment text
source string move or standalone. Shows what caused the comment
hiring_stage_name string Name of the stage when the comment was written
created_by object Author: id (integer), name (string), avatar (string)
created_at string Creation date and time
updated_at string/null Last edit date and time. null until the comment is edited

Example Request

curl 'https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/candidates/91317' \
  --header '<MEKARI_AUTH_HEADERS>'

Example Response

All personal data is replaced with placeholders.

request.description:
Get Hiring Stages (v3)

Returns a paginated list of job openings. Each job opening has four fixed pipeline phases and the number of candidates in each phase.

Method: GET Endpoint: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/hiring-stages

Purpose

Use this endpoint to get the number of candidates in each pipeline phase (Screening, Assessment, Interview, Job Offer) for each job.

This endpoint does not return the hiring stages that are set for a job. The IDs 1 to 4 are phase IDs. They are not valid for hiring_stage_id in Bulk Add Candidates. Use job_hiring_stages[].id from /jobs/:job_id.

Query parameters

Param Type Default Description
page integer 1 Page number. A value that is not an integer, or is below 1, gives 1
per_page integer 10 Items per page. A value that is not an integer, is 0 or less, or is more than 100 gives 10
branch_id string None Filter by branch ID. For more than one ID, use a comma-separated list (example: 1,2)
job_position_id string None Filter by job position ID. For more than one ID, use a comma-separated list
is_publish string None Send 1 to return only jobs with status published. Send any other value (for example 0) to return only jobs that are not published (draft, unpublished, or closed). Do not send the parameter for no filter

Pagination

Use page and per_page to paginate. The response has data.pagination.

Response Body

Field Name Type Description
status string success
message string success
data object Response data
data.job_openings array of object Refer to Job Opening Object
data.pagination object Refer to Pagination Object
request_id string Unique request identifier

1. Job Opening Object

Field Name Type Description
job_opening_id integer Job ID (the same value as job_id in the job endpoints)
talenta_job_id integer Job position ID
company_id integer Company ID in Recruitment
branch_id integer Branch ID. 0 if the job has no branch
position_name string Job position name
status string draft, published, unpublished, or closed
status_label string Draft, Published, Unpublished, or Closed
stages array of object Always 4 items. Refer to Stage Object

2. Stage Object

Field Name Type Description
hiring_stage_id integer Phase ID: 1 Screening, 2 Assessment, 3 Interview, 4 Job Offer
hiring_stage_name string Phase name
hiring_stage_description string Always an empty string
hiring_stage_order integer Position in the list, from 1 to 4
hiring_stage_group_id integer Same value as hiring_stage_id
hiring_stage_group string Screening, Assessment, Interview, or Offer & Hire
is_enable_company_default boolean Always true
company_id integer Company ID in Recruitment
total integer Number of candidates in the phase

Example Request

curl 'https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment/hiring-stages?page=1&per_page=10' \

item.description:
Talenta Recruitment API (v3)

Base URL: https://api.mekari.com/v2/talenta/v3/recruitment

This document has one section for each endpoint. Each section can be copied into the description of a Postman request.

# Method Endpoint Name
1 POST /jobs/bulk-add Bulk Add Jobs
2 POST /candidates/bulk-add Bulk Add Candidates
3 POST /candidates/upload Upload Candidate File
4 GET /jobs Get Job List
5 GET /jobs/:job_id Get Job Detail
6 GET /candidates Get Candidate List
7 GET /candidates/:job_application_id Get Candidate Application Detail
8 GET /hiring-stages Get Hiring Stages
9 GET /reference/provinces Get Provinces
10 GET /reference/provinces/:id/cities Get Cities of a Province
11 GET /reference/educations Get Educations
12 GET /reference/degrees Get Degrees
13 GET /reference/experience-levels Get Experience Levels
14 GET /reference/currencies Get Currencies
15 GET /reference/users Get Users

Recommended order for an integration

  1. Call the reference/\* endpoints, /jobs, and /reference/users to get valid IDs.

  2. Call /jobs/:job_id. Use job_hiring_stages[].id as hiring_stage_id, and custom_question[].id as the id of an answer, in Bulk Add Candidates.

  3. Call /candidates/upload for each file. Keep the file_url.

  4. Call /jobs/bulk-add or /candidates/bulk-add.

Common information

Response envelope

All endpoints return this JSON structure.

Field Name Type Description
status string success or error
message string Operation message
data object or array Response data. Not present on an error
errors array of string Error messages. Present on an error only
request_id string Unique request identifier. Include it in a support request

The sample responses in this document show the data object and the fields around it.

Pagination Object

Field Name Type Description
current_page integer Current page number
first_page_url string First page URL
from integer Starting record number
last_page integer Last page number
last_page_url string Last page URL
next_page_url string Next page URL
path string Base request path
per_page integer Number of records per page
prev_page_url string Previous page URL. Empty string when there is no previous page
to integer Ending record number
total integer Total number of records

Error responses

HTTP status When it occurs message errors (example)
400 An input value is not valid input validation error ["job_id should be integer"]
403 The role of the caller has no access to the endpoint Not present ["Forbidden"]
403 The company is not enabled for these endpoints input validation error ["TDA API is not enabled for this company."]
403 A rule of the service rejects the request (for example, no permission to create a job listing) input validation error ["Authorization check failed. Please verify your permissions and try again."]
404 The company is not found in Recruitment (endpoints 6 and 7) bad request ["company not onboarding to recruitment"]
422 The service cannot process the data (endpoints 2 and 3 only) input validation error Message from the service
500 A server error internal server error ["internal server error - "]

The gateway returns the HTTP status code of the Recruitment service. For these codes, an endpoint that does not handle the code returns 500:

Endpoints Handled codes

2, 3 400, 401, 403, 404, 422

request.description:
Assign Flexible Schedule

This endpoint allows you to assign a flexible schedule to one or more users.

Request Body

  • user_ids (array of integers) - An array of user IDs for whom the flexible schedule is being assigned.

  • effective_start_date (string) - The effective start date for the flexible schedule in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".

  • effective_end_date (string) - The effective end date for the flexible schedule in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".

  • repeat_shift_enabled (boolean) - A boolean value indicating whether the shift should be repeated.

  • shifts (array) - An array of shifts containing the schedule date and office hour IDs.

    • schedule_date (string) - The date of the shift in the format "YYYY-MM-DD".

    • office_hour_ids (array of strings) - An array of office hour IDs for the shift.

Response Body

{
  "message": "string",
  "data": {
    "user_ids": [0],
    "effective_start_date": "string",
    "effective_end_date": "string",
    "repeat_shift_enabled": true,
    "shifts": [
      {
        "schedule_date": "string",
        "office_hour_ids": [0]
      }
    ]
  }
}

The response of this request is documented as a JSON schema. The message field provides a message related to the request, and the data field contains the assigned flexible schedule details for the user(s).

A. Resource Identifier

  • assign schedule behaviours:

    • if trying assign the schedule_id to user who already has the same schedule_id with schedule_id in request body, the response will be 200 OK. But, the effective_date still the same like previous.

    • if we assign different schedule_id to user who already has schedule_id, the effective_date we are passing in request_body will be end_date of existing schedule_id of the user (end_date = effective_date - 1 day).

    • if we assign schedule_id to user who already has schedule_id, the effective_date we are passing should be greather than existing effective_date of schedule_id assigned to that user

Field Name Type Description
message String Response message description (reason of successful and error)
errors Array of String List of error reasons (if any)

Retrieve Schedule Data

This endpoint retrieves schedule data from the Talenta API.

Request Parameters

  • user_ids (string) – Filter by user IDs (comma-separated).

  • page (integer) – Page number (must be a positive integer). Default: 1.

  • limit (integer) – Number of records per page (must be a positive integer). Default: 10. Max: 50.

  • sort (string) – Sorting field. Available options: id_employee, full_name.

  • sort_order (string) – Sort order. Available options: asc, desc.

  • branch_ids (string) – Filter by branch location IDs (comma-separated).

  • organization_ids (string) – Filter by organization IDs (comma-separated).

  • job_level_ids (string) – Filter by job level IDs (comma-separated).

  • job_position_ids (string) – Filter by job position IDs (comma-separated).

  • employment_status_ids (string) – Filter by employment status IDs (comma-separated).

    • inactive – Past schedule (schedule end date < current date).

request.description:
Create Master Schedule

Creates a new master schedule with a defined shift pattern. The schedule captures working day configurations including shift assignments per day, holiday override rules, and flexible working settings. Returns the generated schedule ID on success.

Endpoint

POST /v2/talenta/v3/schedule/master-schedules

A. Request Body

JSON Attribute Type Required Description
name String Yes Display name of the master schedule. Max length: 125 characters.
effective_date String Yes The date from which this schedule becomes active. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
description String No Optional free-text description of the schedule. Max length: 255 characters. Can be null or omitted.
is_ignore_national_holiday Boolean No When true, national holidays are treated as regular working days under this schedule. Allowed values: true, false. Defaults to false when omitted. (Note: not enforced as required in code; defaults to false.)
is_ignore_special_holiday Boolean No When true, special holidays are treated as regular working days under this schedule. Allowed values: true, false. Defaults to false when omitted. (Note: not enforced as required in code; defaults to false.)
is_ignore_company_holiday Boolean No When true, company-defined holidays are treated as regular working days under this schedule. Allowed values: true, false. Defaults to false when omitted. (Note: not enforced as required in code; defaults to false.)
is_flexible Boolean No When true, employees under this schedule use flexible working hours. Enabling this unlocks is_include_late_in and is_include_early_out. Allowed values: true, false. Defaults to false when omitted. (Note: not enforced as required in code; defaults to false.)
is_include_late_in Boolean No When true, late clock-in is tracked for employees under this schedule. Only applicable when is_flexible is true; should be false or omitted when is_flexible is false. Allowed values: true, false.
is_include_early_out Boolean No When true, early clock-out is tracked for employees under this schedule. Only applicable when is_flexible is true; should be false or omitted when is_flexible is false. Allowed values: true, false.
shift_patterns Array Yes Ordered list of shift assignments per day in the schedule pattern. Must contain at least 1 entry, and each day_number must be unique. Each entry defines one calendar day in the pattern cycle. See shift_patterns[] below.

Array: shift_patterns[]

Each object represents a single day in the shift pattern cycle. Day numbering is 1-based. Clients must send one object per day — there is no server-side repeat expansion.

JSON Attribute Type Required Description
day_number Integer Yes The sequential position of this day within the schedule pattern. 1-based (minimum value 1). Must be unique within the array. Example: day_number 1 = first day of the cycle, day_number 4 = fourth day.
shift_id Integer Yes Unique identifier of the master shift to assign on this day (minimum value 1). References an existing shift in the master shift list. Use the day-off shift ID to mark a rest day.

B. Response Body

Field Name Type Nullable Description
message String No Human-readable result message
data Object Yes Result payload; null on failure
errors Array of String Yes List of error reasons; present only on failure
request_id String No Unique request identifier for tracing

Object: data

JSON Attribute Type Description

This endpoint retrieves the details of the form template.

Example

Response

Response Body

The root level of the API response.

Key Type Description
message string Message from the server
data Object The root object containing the requested template data.
request_id string Unique ID of the request

Data Object

Contains the primary identifier and attributes of the template.

Key Type Description
type String The type of the resource (e.g., "template").
id String The unique identifier for the template.
attributes Object Contains all the template's detailed properties and settings.

Attribute Object

The core properties, settings, and structural data of the form template.

Key Type Description
assignees Array List of assigned users.
auto_assign_type String Auto-assign config on the form
category Object Details about the template's category. See Category Object.
created_at String Timestamp of when the template was created (ISO 8601 format).
creator Object Information about the user who created the template. See Creator Object.
criteria_auto_assign Array List of criteria rules for automatic assignment.
description String A brief description of the form template.
is_available_for_new_employee Boolean Indicates if this form is automatically available to new hires.
is_show Boolean Visibility status of the template.
name String The title or name of the template.
notification Object Notification and reminder settings. See Notification Object.
permission Object The viewing, editing, and sharing permissions. See Permission Object.
questions Array of Objects A list of form questions. See Question Object.
submission Object Settings and status regarding form submissions. See Submission Object.
updated_at String Timestamp of the last update to the template (ISO 8601 format).

Category Object

Information regarding how the form is categorized.

Key Type Description
id Number The unique ID of the category.
name String The name of the category (e.g., "default").

Creator Object

Details about the author of the template.

Key Type Description
id Number The user ID of the creator.
name String The full name of the creator.
avatar String URL linking to the creator's profile picture.

Notification Object

Configuration for alerts and reminders related to the form.

Key Type Description
is_notification_enabled Boolean Indicates whether general notifications are turned on.
is_reminder_enabled Boolean Indicates whether automatic reminders are turned on.
notification_type String Type of the notification
effective_date String When the time to be notified
remind_before Number How many days/hours before the deadline a reminder is sent.

Permission Object

Access control and rights for the current user.

Key Type Description
role String The user's role on this document (e.g., "owner").
can_share Boolean Whether the user has rights to share this template.
can_edit Boolean Whether the user has rights to edit this template.
can_view Boolean Whether the user has rights to view this template.

Question Object

Represents an individual field or question within the form.

Key Type Description
id Number The unique internal ID of the question.
uuid String The universal unique identifier for the question.
type Object The input type of the question. See Question Type Object.
label String The actual question text or field label.
description String Additional context or help text for the question.
hide_question_from_approver Boolean Whether this specific question is hidden during the approval process.
is_required Boolean Indicates if an answer is mandatory.
meta_data Object Configuration rules for the question (limits, logic). See Meta Data Object.
options Array of Objects List of options to fill the question. See Question Option Object.

Defines the input mechanism for a specific question.

Key Type Description
id Number The ID representing the field type.
name String The human-readable name of the input type (e.g., "text", "number", "email", "option", "checkbox", "scale", "file").

Validation and logic configuration for a specific question.

Key Type Description
min Number The minimum allowed value or length.
min_label String The label displayed for the minimum value (used primarily in scale questions).
max Number The maximum allowed value or length.
max_label String The label displayed for the maximum value (used primarily in scale questions).
option_other Object Configuration for an "Other" free-text choice. See Option Other Object.
logic Boolean Indicates whether conditional logic (jumping) is applied to this question.

Option Other Object

Settings for allowing users to input a custom choice outside of the predefined options.

Key Type Description
is_enabled Boolean Whether the "Other" option is available to the user.
target String next, end, or Question Unique ID if there is jump logic
target_uuid String Question Unique ID if there is jump logic

Question Option Object

Represents a single selectable choice for multiple-choice, dropdown, or checkbox questions.

Key Type Description
id Number The unique ID of the option.
question_id Number The ID of the question this option belongs to.
sort Number The display order index of the option.
value String The actual text value displayed to the user.
target String next, end, or Question Unique ID if there is jump logic
target_uuid String Question Unique ID if there is jump logic

Submission Object

Rules and data regarding how this form template handles form submissions.

Key Type Description
is_closed Boolean Whether the form is currently closed to new submissions.
closed_at String End of time form submissions
is_need_approval Boolean Whether submissions require manager/admin approval.
url String The direct URL to fill out or view the form submission.
has_submission Boolean Indicates if this template has already received any submissions.
restriction Object Time and frequency constraints for submissions. See Restriction Object.
is_allow_edit_submission Boolean Whether submitters can edit their responses after submitting.

Restriction Object

Limits are placed on when and how often the form can be submitted.

Key Type Description

start_time String Start time when the request can be submitted
end_time String End time when the request can be submitted

Get Assets List

Description

Retrieves a paginated list of company assets with optional filtering and sorting capabilities. This endpoint allows you to search, filter by categories, users, assignment status, and sort the results.

Authorization

This endpoint is authorized only for Super Admin user

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Validation Description
page integer No 1 Min: 1 Page number for pagination
limit integer No 10 Min: 1, Max: 100 Number of items per page
search string No - - Search term for asset name or serial number
user_ids string No - Comma-separated integers Filter assets by assigned user IDs (e.g., "123,456,789")
category_ids string No - Comma-separated integers Filter assets by category IDs (e.g., "1,2,3")
category_names string No - Comma-separated strings Filter assets by category names
assign_status integer No - 0, 1, or 2 Filter by assignment status (0=all, 1=assigned, 2=unassigned)
sort string No - "asc" or "desc" Sort order
sortBy string No - - Field to sort by (e.g., "name", "last_modified")
company_id string No - - Override company ID (optional, defaults to authenticated user's company)

Request Example

Basic request with pagination:

GET /v3/assets?page=1&limit=20

Advanced filtering:

GET /v3/assets?page=1&limit=50&search=laptop&category_ids=1,2&assign_status=1&sort=desc&sortBy=last_modified

Filter by users:

Retrieve Delegation Data

This endpoint retrieves schedule data from the Talenta API.

Request Parameters

  • delegate_from (string) – Filter by delegator IDs (comma-separated).

  • delegate_to (string) – Filter by delegatee IDs (comma-separated).

  • sort (string) – Sorting field.

POST /v3/sbu-groups — Create SBU Group

Creates a new Strategic Business Unit (SBU) Group under the authenticated company.

A. Resource Identifier

This endpoint uses company_id and user_id as resource identifiers.

  • company_id is derived from the SSO/HMAC signature and scopes the SBU Group to the authenticated company.

  • user_id is derived from the SSO token and used for audit purposes.

B. Request Body

Field Type Required (Y/N) Description
sbu_group_name String Y Name of the SBU Group. Must be unique within the company.
description String N Optional description of the SBU Group. Defaults to empty string.

C. Response Body

Field Name Type Description
message String Response message from server
data Object of SBU Group Data The newly created SBU Group record
request_id String Unique identifier for tracing this request

C.1 SBU Group Data Object

Field Name Type Description
id Integer Auto-generated unique ID of the SBU Group
name String Name of the SBU Group as provided in the request
description String Description of the SBU Group as provided in the request
created_at String (ISO 8601) Timestamp when the SBU Group was created, in the company's timezone

D. Sample Response

D.1 Success (200 OK)

{
    "message": "SBU Group created successfully.",
    "data": {
        "id": 1260,
        "name": "Strategic Business Unit Alpha 7",
        "description": "SBU for product alpha division 7",
        "created_at": "2026-05-19T20:51:07+07:00"
    },
    "request_id": "5a4eaa27-aa84-4c77-8586-3fcb22192069"
}

D.2 Validation Error (400 Bad Request)

{
    "message": "Bad request",
    "errors": [
        "payload: name already exists"
    ],
    "request_id": "2989a6d3-0078-4570-82d2-1f8553fd504d"
}

D.3 Unauthorized User (401 Unauthorized)

{
    "message": "Unauthorized",
    "errors": [
        "unauthorized"
    ],
    "request_id": "..."
}

Notes

  • sbu_group_name must be unique within the company. Submitting a duplicate name returns HTTP 400 with "payload: name already exists".

  • description defaults to an empty string if omitted.

  • company_id is automatically derived from the authentication token — do not include it in the request body.

  • The created_at timestamp is returned in ISO 8601 format with the company's configured UTC offset.

  • Pass X-API-Request-ID request header to chain the request_id in the response with the internal X-Request-ID across services.
